The dev who made them appears to have used the spelling "suqka" very widely in the code, which is why I think my pronunciation has some validity.}}}}) are a race of strange-looking but powerful creatures indigenous to [[Lunar Isle]]. Players must have at least started [[Lunar Diplomacy]] to have access to Lunar Isle. Despite their fearsome nature, they have a peaceful relationship with the [[Moon Clan]], but are aggressive to outsiders, effectively serving as guards. Suqah can be a good [[Slayer task]], due to the relatively high amount of [[experience]] per hour that can be gained from killing them with the help of a [[dwarf multicannon]]. However, the use of a dwarf multicannon and prayer potions will also result in a loss of coins due to their lack of valuable drops. Suqah come in two varieties: one that dual-wields melee weapons and uses only melee attacks and another that wields a weapon and a shield, using weaker versions of [[Ice Barrage]] and [[Water Wave]], in addition to melee. When they successfully cast Ice Barrage and the player is not using [[Protect from Magic]], it is guaranteed to hit 10 damage. When combatting suqah, using Protect from Magic, wearing gear with high melee defences, and bringing food is strongly recommended. Suqah spawn in greater numbers on the northern part of the island, making it the preferred spot for players wishing to use a dwarf multicannon. Suqah spawn more sparsely on the southern part of the island, making it a good option for players wishing to [[safespot]] them. There is a safespot next to the tree closest to the [[Oneiromancer]], standing on the bridge will also work, or by any tree. It should be noted that ''both'' the melee and magic hybrid version can be safespotted without the use of prayer, as the hybrid version will not cast spells out of melee range. A [[Seal of Passage]] is required to use the bank located on the Lunar Isle unless the player has completed the [[Dream Mentor]] [[quest]], allowing them to bank with [['Birds-Eye' Jack]], or the [[Elite Fremennik Diary]], allowing them to use any banker. ==Locations== {{LocTableHead}} {{LocLine |name = Suqah |location = North [[Lunar Isle]] |levels = 111 |members = Yes |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 |x:2096,y:3942|x:2108,y:3946|x:2114,y:3938|x:2116,y:3945|x:2117,y:3926|x:2117,y:3951|x:2122,y:3939|x:2133,y:3942|x:2135,y:3930|x:2137,y:3946|x:2142,y:3939|x:2147,y:3944|x:2148,y:3935|x:2149,y:3940|x:2155,y:3943|x:2160,y:3937 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = fremennik }} {{LocLine |name = Suqah |location = South [[Lunar Isle]] |levels = 111 |members = Yes |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 |x:2120,y:3856|x:2136,y:3853|x:2141,y:3856|x:2101,y:3871|x:2106,y:3866|x:2064,y:3880|x:2070,y:3878|x:2075,y:3886|x:2079,y:3882|x:2132,y:3871 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = fremennik }} {{LocLine |name = Suqah |location = [[Lady Zay]] - Cage on the bottom floor |levels = 111 |members = Yes |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 |x:2142,y:3900 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = fremennik }} {{LocTableBottom}} ==Drops== {{DropLogProject|kills=16487910}} {{Average drop value}} ===100%=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Big bones|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsLine|name=Suqah hide|quantity=1|rarity=Always|gemw=No}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ===Pre-roll=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=A special tiara|quantity=1|rarity=1/2|raritynotes=Only dropped during [[Lunar Diplomacy]] after asking [[Meteora]] about her headgear.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/jagexash/status/1541753132589453312|date=28 June 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/98288|archivedate=28 June 2022|quote=50%, available to people who've had the "One o doews Suqah did nick it. Wish I ad it back, yeah." diaogue from Meteora.}}|gemw=No}} {{DropsTableBottom}} {{Reflist|group=d}} ===Other=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Suqah tooth|quantity=1|rarity=69/129|gemw=No}} {{DropsLine|name=Grimy guam leaf|quantity=1|rarity=30/129}} {{DropsLine|name=Grimy marrentill|quantity=1|rarity=25/129}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ===Gem drop table=== {{GemDropTable|5/129|naturetalisman=yes}} ===Tertiary=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLineClue|type=hard|rarity=1/129}} {{DropsLine|name=Long bone|quantity=1|rarity=1/400|gemw=No}} {{DropsLine|name=Curved bone|quantity=1|rarity=1/5012.5|gemw=No}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 25 June 2025 |update = Summer Sweep Up: Combat |change = Suqah now have a 20% elemental weakness to [[earth spells]] and Standard Ranged Defence lowered from 50 to 30. }} {{Subject changes |date = 13 February 2014 |update = Valentine's Day |change = The Suq-A-Nother One reward for slayer now gives more Suqah to kill, not less. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== *During [[Lunar Diplomacy]], it is revealed that Suqah eat minerals from the [[Lunar Isle mine]] to survive. Upon death, they provide the [[Moon Clan]] various resources such as [[suqah hide]], and in exchange, the Moon Clans gives the Suqah magic to defend themselves with.{{CiteNPC|npc=Rimae Sirsalis|quote=It's an interesting creature the Suqah. You see, they have been indigenous to this island since we arrived. They seem to thrive of{{sic}} eating the minerals that exist in the mines below the town. We try our best to live in harmony with them, because they provide us with a great many materials when they die, and in turn we have given them magic to help protect themselves.|loc=Lunar Diplomacy}} *The developer who created Suqah referred to them as "Suqka" within the game's source code. *There are a total of 26 suqahs on [[Lunar Isle]], with a 27th in a cage below the deck of the [[Lady Zay|''Lady Zay'']]. However, a [[clue scroll]] step given by the [[Oneiromancer]] asks how many suqahs are on the island, and requires the answer of 25. ==References== {{reflist}} {{Lunar Isle}}
